name: Historically Grounded Scholar Study
purpose: Provide a positive-content historical scene where anachronism resolution can be tested before composition rather than delegated to a final negative clause.
first_party_baseline_prompt: Create a historically grounded Ming-period portrait in a scholar's study. An adult scholar stands beside a wooden writing table with paper, an inkstone, a brush rest, bound volumes, and a ceramic oil lamp. Lattice windows admit cool evening light while the lamp provides a localized warm glow. The clothing is layered period-inspired woven silk in restrained indigo and earth tones, without modern tailoring cues. Keep the furniture, lighting sources, writing tools, and architecture mutually coherent with the historical setting. Use a full-body environmental composition with floor contact visible and a calm documentary tone.
locked_dimensions: paper, inkstone, brush rest, bound volumes

allowed_experimental_mutation_points.description: Compare conflicting post-hoc negation with a pre-resolved period-compatible positive object while holding the scene constant.

provenance.notes: The prompt is newly authored for AIPF. Private source material informed mechanism selection only; source wording, prompt IDs, images, and creator-specific composition are not embedded.
